sources.title: Tiny Transformer Normaliztaion - a aplominski Collection
sources.snippet: This collection contains models from study about normalization in tiny transformers.

sources.title: aplominski/TinyTransformer-Pre-RMSNorm-10M-TinyStories · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A 10M parameter TinyTransformer model trained on the TinyStories dataset. This model is part of a research series investigating the effect of normalization strategies in small Transformer models.

sources.title: TinyTransformer - GitHub
sources.snippet: Why This Project? Modern language models are often consumed through high-level APIs, making it easy to use them without understanding what happens underneath. TinyTransformer takes the opposite approach. Instead of using a pre-built Transformer implementation, the project builds the core architecture manually:

sources.title: Building a Tiny Transformer From Scratch in PyTorch
sources.snippet: Residual + LayerNorm to stabilize everything. Now it's time to assemble a complete GPT-style language model. Think of it like building a house: we've poured the foundation (embeddings), installed the plumbing and wiring (attention), and added rooms (blocks). The Tiny Transformer is the full house, ready to be lived in. Step 1.

sources.title: TinyTransformer | datawhalechina/tiny-universe | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: TinyTransformer is a standalone implementation of the Transformer architecture as introduced in the paper "Attention Is All You Need". It provides a complete, from-scratch implementation of the Transformer model using PyTorch, with detailed explanations of each component.
